simplemachines.guide.page.1.title: Simple Machines
simplemachines.guide.page.1: The machine parts of the Simple Machines tab:
simplemachines.guide.page.2.title: Simple Machines
simplemachines.guide.page.2: three faster hoppers with an item filter and their hopper carts, four stronger pistons, the Double Piston,
simplemachines.guide.page.3.title: Simple Machines
simplemachines.guide.page.3: which reaches further than any Vanilla piston, and the Signal Dampener, a repeater that takes up to 3 off the signal.
simplemachines.guide.page.4.title: Reinforced, Netherite and Enderite Hoppers
simplemachines.guide.page.4: Three faster hoppers: the Reinforced Hopper (4 ticks between transfers), the Netherite Hopper (2) and the Enderite Hopper (1; Vanilla 8), each with an item filter in its menu.
simplemachines.guide.page.5.title: Reinforced, Netherite and Enderite Hoppers
simplemachines.guide.page.5: Until 03.11. SimpleBuilding's; old simplebuilding: ids and saved hoppers move here.
simplemachines.guide.page.6.title: Hopper Minecarts
simplemachines.guide.page.6: A hopper minecart per hopper tier: it takes in 2, 4 or 8 items per tick (the speed of its hopper; Vanilla's cart 1) and filters like the hopper block, with the same menu.
simplemachines.guide.page.7.title: Piston upgrades
simplemachines.guide.page.7: Four stronger pistons: the Reinforced Piston and its sticky twin push 18 blocks and, paid with a Redstone Block, one unbreakable block;
simplemachines.guide.page.8.title: Piston upgrades
simplemachines.guide.page.8: the Netherite and Enderite Pistons break blocks by signal strength, wear out like tools and are repaired with their nugget. Until 03.11. SimpleBuilding's; old simplebuilding: ids move here.
simplemachines.guide.page.9.title: Double Piston
simplemachines.guide.page.9: One block that pushes in two stages: a signal of 1 to 7 brings the head out one block like a Vanilla piston, 8 to 15 slides an arm out of it and moves the head a second block - three blocks long in all.
simplemachines.guide.page.10.title: Signal Dampener
simplemachines.guide.page.10: A flat redstone part like the Repeater that takes 0 to 3 off the signal and passes it on one redstone tick later.
simplemachines.guide.page.11.title: Creative tabs
simplemachines.guide.page.11: The module's items sit in its own creative tab only (no Vanilla tabs).
simplemachines.guide.page.12.title: Commands
simplemachines.guide.page.13.title: Settings
simplemachines.guide.page.13: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
jade.simplemachines.hopper.nothing: No filter items set: accepts nothing
